messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "injected under the skin once per week at any time of the day with or without food"
set: ["injected under the skin once per week at any time of the day with or without food", "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals", "can be given with or without meals at any time of the day", "take with food at the same time each day", "take once a day in the morning, with or without food", "give once weekly at any time of day, with or without meals", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "with or without food", "taken once daily with or without food", "take once daily with or without food", "take with or without food", "can be taken at any time of day", "always with food or always without food", "clean the plastic actuator with the canister removed at least once a week", "take at around the same time each day", "taken at approximately the same time each day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals",
    "give once weekly at any time of day, with or without meals",
    "with or without food",
    "taken once daily with or without food",
    "take once daily with or without food",
    "take with or without food",
    "can be taken at any time of the day",
    "take at around the same time each day",
    "taken at approximately the same time each day"
  ],
  "alias": "with or without food"
}
